checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan Weft 0.2.0 Act II: add six frozen chambers (10x10-12x12, 8-9 threads), regenerate deterministically, update tests, UI copy, README and ADR

impact_assessment.why: The campaign ends at 12 chambers and 9x9, so the game has no fresh content after about twenty minutes; the generator, engine and UI are already size-agnostic, so a second act is the cheapest meaningful expansion.
impact_assessment.benefits: Six larger chambers extend the campaign to eighteen and give the existing best-time, hint and unlock systems more to reward; the Play build gets a visible v0.2 content update with no new dependency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: TOTAL_CHAMBERS, the level index, dogfood expectations and README table change; dependency: none (same generator, stdlib Node); concurrency: single writer, weft tree clean; state: progress v1 stores solved ids, so new ids append without a schema bump
impact_assessment.mitigation: Update the expectations first and watch them fail, generate from fixed new seeds, prove all 18 solutions total and solvable, then run the full project gates, dogfood and UI verify before any commit.

[1/5] Plan Weft 0.3.0: derive 1-3 stars from hint use, preserve the best star rating across runs, show stars on chamber cards and the victory dialog, and total them on the title and chamber index

impact_assessment.why: Best time is the only progression signal after a solve; hints are recorded but never surfaced, so a clean solve and a hinted solve look identical on the chamber index and the eighteen chambers have only one replay goal.
impact_assessment.benefits: A legible 0-54 star total gives every chamber a second goal, rewards replaying without the hint ghost, and makes old saves useful immediately by deriving stars from their stored hint counts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: progress entries gain an additive stars field and the win dialog/chamber cards gain star elements; dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: weft.progress.v1 stays version 1, and existing entries without stars normalize from hints
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for star derivation, max-star preservation and totals; dogfood asserts a clean three-star solve and the saved record; visual render check before the commit and a post-commit UI blessing

[1/6] Plan Weft 0.4.0 Daily Weave: share the pure Hamiltonian generator, build a date-seeded 7x7 chamber, store it under a separate daily save with streaks, add title/chamber-index entry and a copyable result, then sync the Play catalog

impact_assessment.why: The eighteen-chamber campaign is finite, so after the stars there is no reason to return; a date-seeded daily chamber gives a fresh puzzle every day without a backend, an account or a network call.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic daily loom, a separate streak and result record, and one-click sharing add retention while keeping campaign progress untouched; the shared generator removes the risk of a second, drifting level implementation.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new game and UI modules, a new weft.daily.v1 key, and new title/chamber-index controls; dependency: none, pure ES modules; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: daily saves are separate from weft.progress.v1, and local-date keys must not drift across time zones
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract the existing generator verbatim and prove the frozen chambers are unchanged, unit-test date keys, determinism, validity, storage and streaks, dogfood today's daily solve, and leave campaign progress untouched
